state.review_task: Classify the strongest defensible behavior claim from one synchronized matched capture. Do not infer game facts beyond this packet and do not override owner testimony.
state.owner_testimony: Kakashi SELECT creates a timed substitution status.
matched_design: Both trials loaded the same fight-CPU savestate, used the same 500-frame schedule, and had zero dropped or gapped tail frames.
Both held DOWN through relative frame 210 so Kakashi remained active through early attacks; only the treatment pressed SELECT at relative frames 220-221.
No pause menu or COM-setting change occurred after SELECT.
Kakashi was character 23 in active P1 slot 0 throughout both trials.
observations: The traces matched through relative frame 383 except for SELECT activation state 12 at frames 233-292 and treatment-only candidate fields.
At relative frame 384 the control entered hit state 8 and HP fell 9216 to 9024; the SELECT trial instead entered state 20 and HP remained 9216.
The control continued losing HP in that attack sequence. The SELECT trial first lost HP at relative frame 461 and entered hit state 8.
After the frame-384 divergence the fighters' states and positions no longer matched, so the later hits are not a matched attack comparison.
constraints: Separate observed behavior, attribution, and internal mechanism.
State 20 is an observed treatment-only transition, not an independently identified internal mechanism.
A later damaging hit after trajectories diverge cannot by itself distinguish one-hit consumption from timer expiry.

attribution.instructions: What is the strongest attribution supported at the first corresponding CPU hit?

criteria.select_associated_protection: The matched contrast supports SELECT-associated protection from that hit under the recorded conditions.
criteria.correlation_only: The contrast is recorded but an uncontrolled pre-hit difference prevents attribution to SELECT.
criteria.inadequate_signal: Identity, HP, attack, or capture integrity is inadequate.
criteria.unknown_omitted_alternative: An important omitted alternative prevents judgment.

claim_scope.instructions: What is the strongest behavior claim supported by the whole capture?

criteria.one_corresponding_hit: SELECT protected one corresponding hit in this fixture and the protection was not indefinite.
criteria.one_hit_consumption: The first protected hit consumed the status.
criteria.timed_duration_bracket: The capture establishes a specific duration or reliable duration bracket.
criteria.internal_mechanism: The capture identifies the internal substitution mechanism.
